about: A test of the flight look on one page of the Wang Bi lesson, before changing the lesson. The user, 2026-09-27, on what they liked in Alien's screens: 'There was sound effects, there was vector graphics, there was movement and panning and zoom. It was transporting you into a specific view of the world, which is in the infographic.' See docs/research/2026-09-27-nostromo-screens.md. The view approaches 22 while its lines plot (a relay click each), goes down to L5 as the answer types (a printer's chatter), then circles the upper trigram; a hum under the music; the screen pushed in on slowly, bowed and bloomed like a tube. Round 2, the user: 'boost the sound and take out the music and see what it's like.'
